statement: This sketch explores the dynamic interplay between solid architectural forms and luminous energy through a constantly shifting environment of light rays and geometric planes. The scene features a collection of abstract building surfaces that subtly animate in space, while thousands of rays emanate from a central light source, casting and re-casting their paths across these forms. Where the rays intersect with the architectural geometry, crystalline clusters form—representing the precise points where light meets structure. The visualization creates an ever-changing dance of illumination and shadow, revealing how light interacts with form in a mesmerizing, abstract representation of architectural lighting dynamics.
